column1: # comment: Rights / IP / trademark / licensing alignments (#21). MACHINE-READABLE RIGHTS: gmeow:RightsStatement is the canonical superset of an ODRL Policy / Set (W3C ODRL 2.2); gmeow:Permission / gmeow:Prohibition / gmeow:Duty are the odrl:Permission / odrl:Prohibition / odrl:Duty rule trio, and gmeow:ruleAction values (reproduce / distribute / derive / commercialize / attribute / share-alike / …) are the odrl:action vocabulary, exactMatch the CC REL permission/requirement/prohibition classes (cc:Reproduction, cc:DerivativeWorks, cc:Attribution, cc:ShareAlike, cc:CommercialUse). The full ODRL policy and CC REL licence are GENERATED projections (queries/projections/odrl.rq, cc.rq). LICENCE-IS-AGREEMENT: gmeow:License (⊑ gmeow:Agreement) closeMatch cc:License / odrl:Offer / dcterms:LicenseDocument; gmeow:hasLicense exactMatch dcterms:license, closeMatch schema:license / cc:license. ATTRIBUTION REUSE: gmeow:copyrightHolder / gmeow:trademarkHolder (⊑ gmeow:wasAttributedTo) exactMatch dcterms:rightsHolder, closeMatch schema:copyrightHolder; gmeow:attributionText closeMatch schema:creditText / cc:attributionName. COPYRIGHT STATUS: gmeow:CopyrightStatus values closeMatch the RightsStatements.org standardized statements (InC / NKC / CNE) and the CC public-domain mark; the facility relates to PREMIS 3 rights (premis:RightsStatement). DISTINCT FROM the ontology-alignment LinkPolicy (src/gmeow_tools/config.py): that governs whether an external vocabulary's AXIOMS may be copied INTO GMEOW; this facility governs the rights of the INSTANCES GMEOW describes. The gmeow:LicenseFamily value vocabulary is the ontology-side reflection of that classification, not a copy of it.
